title: Let Go
coreMove: Let go by drawing the Stoic control line: release the outcome, the old argument, or the ego-bound position, then spend your strength on the next right act.

exampleSpecs.stakes: stop replaying a finished outcome and protect the next delivery
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A short exchange shows the Stoic control line without a speech

exampleSpecs.stakes: redirect effort from weather complaints to safe work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The pause itself changes the routine

exampleSpecs.audience: front desk workers after missed handoffs
exampleSpecs.stakes: keep one complaint from owning the whole shift
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A close detail lets the lesson land quietly

exampleSpecs.stakes: learn from a call without relitigating what crews could not command
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Evidence after the outcome separates effort from uncontrollable result

exampleSpecs.stakes: protect judgment when ego is tied to a stated position
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The protagonist notices her own defense and releases the position

exampleSpecs.stakes: write a boundary that preserves duty without promising control
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A written artifact carries the action
